proposals.title: Prefer places famous for what's underneath
proposals.change: Research and the planner favour places whose underground is the famous part (underground cities, catacombs, cisterns, under-river metros, deepest stations, officially public bunkers) over landmarks whose underground is only foundations and utilities. Research applies it when sourcing; no code change.
proposals.expectedEffect: more Shorts from topics with 1M+ breakout references
proposals.risk: fewer famous-skyline landmarks; sourcing deep layers is harder
